title: iamar style profile (style.json)
description: One world look: palette, weathering, dimensions, materials, glTF material recipes, atmosphere reference, budgets and lint tolerances. kit/style/iamar/style.json is the iamar profile; a world either ships its own style.json (Track B) or one that says {"extends": "iamar"} and overrides what it changes (Track A). Checked by kit/style/check_style.py. Engineering rules (budgets, closure, culling, LOD, bakes) are NOT style: they apply to every world and live in the recipes; a profile may only tighten budgets.

extends.description: Id of a profile under kit/style/<id>/style.json whose values this one starts from (deep merge, this file wins).

sources.description: Where the numbers come from (repository and commit), so they can be re-checked.

palette.description: Named base colours. Each entry: hex, optional pattern (material layer it is painted with) and source.

regions.description: Per-area palettes (the city's quarters; a custom world's districts or biomes).

dimensions.description: Scale and proportion rules in metres (or ratios where named). P3 lint checks models against them.

roof_pitch_rise_per_run.description: Allowed roof pitches: rise over half the roof's short span (the lint takes min-max).

roof_height_fraction.description: Roof height / whole model height; the lint uses it when no pitches are given (flat-roofed looks).

arch_rise_half_span.description: Arch rise / half its span (1 = semicircular).

layers.description: Material name -> how this style uses it. `layer` names a painter layer (paint_materials.py --list); `tint` is the colour it is painted to.

material_recipes.description: Looks the city draws with its own shaders, restated as what a package can carry (glTF metallic-roughness, emissive, alpha, KHR_materials_unlit). A package cannot ship shaders.

presets.description: Values for scene.environment (docs/WORLD_FORMAT.md 4.1). Only fields that exist there.

budgets.description: Triangle budgets at LOD0 per asset class and frame targets. A profile may tighten, never loosen, the engineering budgets.

lint.description: Tolerances the style lint (job P3) reads.

palette_max_off_share.description: Share of a model's triangles that may be off the palette.

vertex_bad_share.description: Share of a material's sampled surface (vertex colours, texture at its UVs) that may break a colour rule.

min_efficiency.description: An over-budget model whose Efficiency (100 x budget / triangles) is lower fails the lint.

neighbour_m.description: Two placements of one building or landmark at the same scale closer than this are repeated neighbours.

flat_wall_max_m.description: kit/audit/flat_wall.py: longest wall a walker sees at eye height with no opening, arch or relief, in metres. Absent: the audit is skipped (a Track B world decides by its own style bible).

shot_palette_delta_e.description: compare-shots: how close (delta E, lightness halved) a pixel must be to a profile colour to count as on-palette.

shot_palette_drop.description: compare-shots: largest allowed fall of the on-palette pixel share.

shot_black_rise.description: compare-shots: largest allowed rise of the black pixel share.

shot_ground_cast.description: compare-shots: largest allowed colour distance (Lab) between a day shot's ground and the profile's ground colours; above it the shot fails (default 9).

shot_ground_colours.description: compare-shots: extra ground colours (hex) a day shot's ground may match, besides the profile's own ground materials.

timber_frame_weights.description: style-gen house: relative weights of the upper storeys' timber frame, [plain, centre post, close studding, studs with corner braces, cross-braced] (kit/style/gen/frame.py). A region's weights win over dimensions'; a profile with neither builds plain walls.

glow.description: Emissive in the world (lamps, embers, glowing magic): exempt from the lint's darkness and saturation rules.

allow_dark.description: A deliberate dark (door openings, chimney mouths), never a lit surface: exempt from the darkness rule.
